title: Automated Lead Qualification & CRM Management
summary: Automates customer enquiry collection, qualifies leads by budget, updates a Google Sheets CRM, and sends personalized email notifications.
description: Built with n8n, this workflow captures customer enquiries through an online form and automatically classifies leads into High Priority or Standard Priority based on predefined budget rules. It updates or creates CRM records in Google Sheets, prevents duplicate entries using email matching, sends customer acknowledgement emails, and alerts the business owner about high-priority leads. It also calculates follow-up dates, validates submissions, handles workflow errors, and maintains an execution log.

title: Customer Feedback Collector with Negative-Review Alerts
summary: An n8n automation that logs customer feedback, sends rating-based follow-up emails, and alerts the business owner on Telegram the moment a customer is unhappy.
description: Small businesses often miss unhappy customers until it is too late to win them back. When a customer submits an n8n-hosted feedback form, the workflow cleans and classifies the response by rating, logs it to Google Sheets, and sends a tailored follow-up email through Gmail. Negative feedback triggers an instant Telegram alert to the owner and is marked as alerted in the sheet, while a separate error workflow emails the owner if any step fails.
